note: Export activity is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs records with destination, HS code and B/L number — 5 distinct shipments Dec 2025 – Feb 2026 to South Korea, USA (x2), Japan and Belgium, all tungsten chemicals (ammonium paratungstate, ammonium metatungstate, sodium tungstate, tungsten trioxide). Role: appears to be a manufacturer-exporter of tungsten chemicals ("MADE IN INDIA" on invoice, own GIDC Vatva plant address), though the free view does not prove manufacturing vs. trading — role best recorded as manufacturer_trader/unknown pending confirmation.
